action_inputs.description: true enables every environment on the server tier; false leaves the tier's environment setting unchanged.
action_inputs.label: Enable all environments (true/false, default true)
action_inputs.name: onb_all_environments

action_inputs.description: ENV- ids or names, one per line, that receive the hostname template; left empty the template goes on the server tier.
action_inputs.label: Environments to attach (optional)
action_inputs.name: onb_environments

action_inputs.description: CloudBolt hostname template with a sequence: zeros followed by X, for example poc-00X (becomes poc-001, poc-002). A template with '#' or without a sequence is refused.
action_inputs.label: Hostname template (optional)
action_inputs.name: onb_hostname_template

label: POC Onboarding: Configure Custom Server
mcp_tool_description: Make the shipped Custom Server blueprint orderable for the POC: recreate it from the shipped definition when it is missing, set it ACTIVE and orderable, enable every environment on its server tier (onb_all_environments=false leaves the tier as it is), and set onb_hostname_template on the server tier, or on each environment in onb_environments when given, so the order form previews the generated hostname (test plan 1.1.4). Group entitlement is manage_blueprint_permissions. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
